release_policy.explicit_release: Emit release through the fixed registry before every source-explicit free or munmap for a recorded allocation.
release_policy.implicit_destructor: A recorded allocation released only by C++ member destruction may omit a source release record if the integration manifest names process_exit as its lifetime end.
release_policy.process_exit: Live-at-stream-terminal allocations are diagnostic facts, not stream-integrity failures; the terminal process receipt proves kernel reclamation separately.
release_policy.free_without_record: Invalid when the source integration manifest declares an explicit release site.

runner_contract.descriptor: fresh inherited O_APPEND descriptor, absent from the codec command text only if separately bound in the environment manifest
runner_contract.descriptor_identity: fstat regular-file device and inode or pipe identity captured before and after execution
runner_contract.environment: GAMMA_ALLOCATION_MARKER_FD contains only the decimal descriptor
runner_contract.close: runner closes its copy after fork/exec handoff and closes the evidence descriptor after child terminal
runner_contract.health: missing records, invalid descriptor syntax, a latched marker failure, or a terminal health-check failure makes attribution invalid
